questions.question_text: In a school there are 225 girls and 190 boys. Work out the number of boys as a fraction of the total number of students. Give your answer in its lowest terms.
In a school there are 225 girls and 190 boys. Write the ratio number of girls : number of boys in its simplest form.
In a mathematics class there are 15 boys. The ratio number of girls : number of boys = 6 : 5. Find the number of girls in this class.
In a science class of 33 students there are 15 boys. Find the number of boys as a percentage of the number of students in the class.
In a science class of 33 students there are 15 boys. 20% of these boys did not complete an experiment. Work out the number of boys who did not complete the experiment.

This year the number of students studying mathematics is 390. This is an increase of 4% on the number of students who studied mathematics last year. Work out the number of students who studied mathematics last year.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle P.
Reflect triangle T in the y-axis.
Translate triangle T by the vector (5 / 6).
Stretch triangle T, stretch factor 3 and x-axis invariant.
A is the point (0, 2) and B is the point (2, 7). Write AB as a column vector.
A is the point (0, 2) and B is the point (2, 7). BC = 2AB. Find the co-ordinates of C.
f(x) = x + 1/(2x), x != 0. On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -3 and 3.
f(x) = x + 1/(2x), x != 0. Find the co-ordinates of the local minimum point.
f(x) = x + 1/(2x), x != 0. Find the range of f(x) for x > 0.
f(x) = x + 1/(2x), x != 0. Write down the equations of the two asymptotes to the graph of y = f(x).
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = 2^x - 3 for -2 <= x <= 3.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = 6 log x for x > 0.
Solve the inequality 6 log x > 2^x - 3.
The table shows the scores of 10 students in a mathematics test and in a physics test. Find the median and the upper quartile of the physics scores.
The table shows the scores of 10 students in a mathematics test and in a physics test. Write down the type of correlation between the mathematics scores and the physics scores.
The table shows the scores of 10 students in a mathematics test and in a physics test. Find the equation of the line of regression in the form y = mx + c.
Calculate the area of the triangle with sides 11 cm, x cm, and 23 cm, and an included angle of 50°.
Calculate the value of x for the triangle with sides 11 cm, x cm, and 23 cm, and an included angle of 50°.
The population of a small town is decreasing at a rate of 5% every 10 years. The population is now 26010. Calculate the population in 20 years time. Give your answer correct to the nearest 100.
The population was previously increasing at a rate of 2% each year. The population is now 26010. Calculate the population 2 years ago.
The population was previously increasing at a rate of 2% each year. The population is now 26010. Find the number of complete years since the population was last less than 20000.
f(x) = 1 + 4x - x^2. On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for -1 <= x <= 5.
f(x) = 1 + 4x - x^2. Write down the equation of the line of symmetry of the graph of y = f(x).
f(x) = 1 + 4x - x^2. Find the zeros of f(x).
f(x) = 1 + 4x - x^2. Solve the inequality f(x) >= 0.
f(x) = 1 + 4x - x^2. Solve the equation f(x) + 1 = 0.
g(x) = 5 - x. On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = g(x) for -1 <= x <= 5.
On the diagram, shade the region where y <= f(x) and y <= g(x).
When Helena goes for a walk, she walks d kilometres. The probability that 0 < d <= 2 is 1/5 and the probability that 2 < d <= 4 is 1/4. Find the probability that d > 4.

If it rains, Helena never goes for a walk. If it does not rain, Helena always goes for a walk. On any day, the probability that it rains is 1/3. Complete the tree diagram showing the probabilities of the two events.
Find the probability that, on any day, Helena walks more than 2km.
Find the expected number of days that Helena walks more than 2km, during a period of 90 days.
The diagram shows a pyramid of height 7 cm on a rectangular base 8 cm by 6 cm. The point P is directly above the centre of the base. Calculate the angle between the triangle PBC and the base ABCD.
The diagram shows a pyramid of height 7 cm on a rectangular base 8 cm by 6 cm. The point P is directly above the centre of the base. Calculate the angle between PB and the base ABCD.
The diagram shows a pyramid of height 7 cm on a rectangular base 8 cm by 6 cm. The point P is directly above the centre of the base. Calculate PC.
The diagram shows a pyramid of height 7 cm on a rectangular base 8 cm by 6 cm. The point P is directly above the centre of the base. Calculate angle PCB.
The diagram shows a pyramid of height 7 cm on a rectangular base 8 cm by 6 cm. X is a point on the line PC so that angle BXC = 60°. Calculate BX.
The mass, m grams, of each of 200 potatoes is measured. The histogram shows the results. Complete the frequency table.
The mass, m grams, of each of 200 potatoes is measured. Calculate an estimate of the mean.
The perimeter of the rectangle with dimensions (3x + 2) cm and (x + 1) cm is 44 cm. Find the value of x.
The area of the rectangle with dimensions y cm and (y - 1) cm is 272 cm^2. Find the value of y.
The two rectangles have the same length, w cm. The areas are 5 cm^2 and 7 cm^2, and their widths are v cm and (v + 1) cm. Find the value of v.
The perimeter of the larger rectangle with area 10 cm^2 and base 3p cm is 2 cm more than the perimeter of the smaller rectangle with area 9 cm^2 and base 2p cm. Find the value of p.
f(x) = 1 - x, g(x) = 3x - 2, h(x) = |x^2 - 4|, k(x) = 3x^2 + 2. Find, giving your answer in its simplest form, g(f(x)).
f(x) = 1 - x, g(x) = 3x - 2, h(x) = |x^2 - 4|, k(x) = 3x^2 + 2. Find, giving your answer in its simplest form, g(x) * f(x) + k(x).
